text_block_list.text:
I came to the infirmary to have Cheval 
Grand treated after she was injured during 
training.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for the trouble...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I can go right back to training, right? 
It was just a little fall, after all...
choice_data_list:
...True, it doesn't look like a major 
injury, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I was just getting warmed up. I really 
want to finish today's training menu.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer...
choice_data_list:
I'm worried, so let's treat those injuries 
and rest.

Then let's brace ourselves and give it our 
all!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...A-Are you taking a break? I'm sure I'll 
be fine with just this much...
choice_data_list:
"Great Umamusume" are masters at switching 
gears!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ............ ...Yes. Understood.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I was rushing things. Today is a 
no-fishing day... I'll focus on resting.

After finishing the treatment, I escorted 
Cheval Grand back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...! Thank you so much...! I'll practice 
hard and become a "great Umamusume"...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Wawa...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... The pain is kind of getting 
worse... Maybe I took it too lightly...

To avoid aggravating her condition any 
further, Cheval Grand decided to rest her 
body.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. Could you help tape me up?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Just in case.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Before setting sail into rough seas... A 
temporary measure at the port, just in 
case.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...This much should be fine...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Alright... I'll continue while being 
careful.

With the taping applied, Cheval Grand was 
able to continue her training within a 
safe, reasonable limit.
